Dune: Part Two: After House Atreides falls, Paul and his mother find refuge among the Fremen of Arrakis. As Paul grows closer to Chani and joins the fight against the Harkonnens, others begin to see him as the figure foretold in their prophecies. His visions warn him what embracing that role could cost.
Interstellar: As crop failures threaten humanity's survival, former pilot Cooper joins a mission through a wormhole near Saturn to search for a habitable world. The journey takes him far from his daughter Murph, and on some of the worlds he visits, a few hours can mean years for the people he left behind.
Oppenheimer: During World War II, physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer brings together a team of scientists at Los Alamos to build an atomic bomb. The film follows his rise from academic to wartime leader and the security hearings that later call his judgment, loyalties and legacy into question.
Inception: Dom Cobb makes a living stealing secrets from people's dreams. A client offers him the chance to go home if he can do the reverse: plant an idea so convincing that the target believes it is his own. Cobb recruits a team to build the dream, but his memories threaten to disrupt their plan.
The Dark Knight: Batman, Lieutenant Gordon and district attorney Harvey Dent are closing in on Gotham's criminal networks when the Joker arrives. His attacks turn the city's trust in its protectors into a weapon, forcing Bruce Wayne to reckon with the limits of what Batman can do.
The Matrix: By day, Thomas Anderson works at a software company. At night, he hacks under the name Neo and searches for an answer to a question he can't shake. When Morpheus and Trinity find him, they offer a way out of the world he knows and a place in a resistance fighting to free humanity.
Avatar: The Way of Water: When an old enemy returns to Pandora, Jake Sully and Neytiri take their children far from the forest and seek refuge with the Metkayina reef clan. The family must learn a new way of life in the ocean, while the danger they tried to leave behind draws closer.
Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse: Miles Morales is juggling school, family and life as Brooklyn's Spider-Man when Gwen Stacy returns. Her arrival leads him to a society of Spider-People guarding the multiverse, where a disagreement about who can be saved puts Miles at odds with the heroes he hoped would understand him.
Barbie: Barbie's days in Barbieland follow a familiar routine until she starts having thoughts she can't explain and her perfectly arched feet go flat. She travels to the real world for answers with Ken in tow. What they each discover there changes how they see themselves and the world they came from.
The Batman: In his second year as Gotham's masked vigilante, Bruce Wayne follows a trail of riddles left by a killer targeting the city's most powerful people. The investigation draws him into an uneasy alliance with Selina Kyle and brings him closer to secrets linking Gotham's institutions to his own family.
Everything Everywhere All at Once: Evelyn Wang arrives at a tax audit already stretched thin by her laundromat and family. Then a version of her husband from another universe tells her she can tap into the skills of the people she might have become. As those lives collide, the choices that matter most bring her back to her daughter.
Whiplash: Andrew Neiman, a first-year jazz drummer at a prestigious conservatory, earns a spot in Terence Fletcher's studio band. Fletcher's approval can make a young musician's career, but his methods push Andrew to sacrifice relationships, rest and his own sense of where ambition should stop.
